+`cx docs compile` is the downstream synthesis step. It consumes one of
+those bundles and writes final docs to the profile target paths or to
+explicit output paths you provide. Use `cx notes extract` when you need a
+reviewable prompt bundle. Use `cx docs compile` when you are ready to
+materialize the downstream document artifact.
+

+When you are ready to write the downstream document artifact, use
+`cx docs compile --profile <name>` or point `cx docs compile --bundle ...`
+at an existing extracted bundle. That keeps extraction and document
+materialization as separate, reviewable stages.
